name: Fab 34

parties.name: Apollo-managed funds
parties.note: Apollo-managed funds held a 49% equity interest in a joint venture entity tied to Fab 34 from 2024, while Intel kept ownership and operating control of the fab itself; Intel agreed in April 2026 to buy the stake back and reported the repurchase completed.

process_nodes.label: Intel 3
process_nodes.note: An Intel executive said in July 2026 that no other Intel factory runs Intel 3.

summary: Intel's EUV logic fab at its Leixlip campus in County Kildare, Ireland, part of a 2022 plan to add €12 billion and double manufacturing space in Ireland. The first module began high-volume Intel 4 production in September 2023, the first EUV volume manufacturing in Europe, and the fab also makes Intel 3 products. Apollo-managed funds bought a 49% stake in a Fab 34 joint venture in 2024, which Intel repurchased in 2026 for $14.2 billion. Intel expects to complete construction of Fab 34, and in July 2026 it announced a €5 billion programme, under way since earlier that year, to upgrade the existing Leixlip fabs and install new equipment, with Fab 34 at its centre.
